pins.title: How to Do Aegyo Sal: Easy Korean Under Eye Makeup
pins.sub: Four small steps with one palette

items.title: Find the fold
items.body: Smile. It's the puffy band under the lashes.

items.title: Light beige on top
items.body: Pat a matte or satin beige on the fold, inner two thirds.

items.title: Thin shadow below
items.body: A soft brown line under the fold, centre of the eye.

items.title: Blend the edges
items.body: Clean fingertip or small brush, no hard line.
